nodes.label: Backend API
nodes.rationale: REST API that is the frontend's only entry point; manages projects, documents, jobs, structure and creates ingest jobs.

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.rationale: No server-side rendering; the whole app is client-side.

nodes.label: Frontend (SPA)
nodes.rationale: Single-page app for uploading documents and reviewing/editing the detected structure; talks to Backend API over HTTP.

nodes.label: Ingest Worker
nodes.rationale: Runs independently of the API so a large document never blocks the app; one job at a time through extraction -> structuring -> chunking -> embedding.

nodes.label: Local File Storage
nodes.rationale: Keeps original uploads on disk outside the DB so documents can be reprocessed without re-upload.

nodes.label: ltree extension
nodes.rationale: Fast queries over the section tree.

nodes.label: Ollama local model server
nodes.rationale: Loads one model at a time; embedder and generator are never needed simultaneously.

nodes.label: Postgres (single data store)
nodes.rationale: The only database: structure, text and embeddings live in one place.

nodes.label: Query Engine
nodes.rationale: Runs per chat request, not in background; retrieves, reranks, and has the generator answer using only retrieved passages.

nodes.label: Reranker (in-process)
nodes.rationale: Runs inside the Query Engine process rather than via Ollama, since reranking doesn't fit a chat-style API.
